extensionDescription.message: Customize X: copy post URLs directly, default to images, and hide Premium, Grok explanations, and image editing buttons.

directCopyDescription.message: Replace Share on Home with a button that copies the post URL.

imagesFirstDescription.message: Select images by default when opening a profile's Media tab.

hideGrokExplainDescription.message: Hide the “Explain this post” button at the top right of posts.

hideImageEditDescription.message: Hide the “Edit image” button that appears when you hover over an image.

hidePremiumDescription.message: Hide Premium in the sidebar and subscription prompts on Home and profiles.
